doc: A shell subscription (kind = shell, every = 30s) is the kernel's only cron: it runs the command once per period with no model turn.

breaks.detail: a 30s shell subscription ran 3 time(s) in 40 s (expected 1, at most 2)
2 model turn(s) for a deliver_to = user shell subscription; the reading must reach the user with no model turn
